'''University Proctor''' was a position held by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Eren Garai]] at [[Phelar University]]. Garai, an [[Agent/Legends|agent]] of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] and lead of their operations at the [[University/Legends|university]], was installed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] bureau as a proctor of the institution so that [[Gender/Legends|he]] may keep a secret watch for subversive activity.
